units.source_text: 僧都听了这话，想道：“果然不出我之所料。

en.t: When the bishop heard this, he thought, "It is just as I expected.

units.source_text: 我看那女子的模样，原知道不是平常人。

en.t: From the look of that young woman, I knew from the start that she was no ordinary person.

units.source_text: 薰大将如此说，可知他对这女子的宠爱不浅。

en.t: Since General Kaoru speaks this way, it is clear that his affection for her is far from slight.

units.source_text: 我虽然是法师，岂可不分皂白，立刻答应而替她改装落了发呢？”

en.t: Though I am a monk, how could I agree at once, without knowing right from wrong, and change her dress and cut off her hair?"

units.source_text: 他心中狼狈，不知道怎样回答才好。

en.t: He was flustered inwardly and did not know how best to answer.

units.source_text: 又想：“他一定闻悉实情了。

en.t: Then he thought, "He must have heard the true facts.

units.source_text: 如此详知情状而向我探问，我已无可隐瞒。

en.t: If he knows the circumstances in such detail and is questioning me, I have nothing left to hide.

units.source_text: 强要隐瞒，反而不好。”

en.t: If I insist on concealing it, that will only make matters worse."

units.source_text: 他略略想了一想，答道：“确有一人，贫僧近来心中常常觉得惊讶，不知此人究竟为了何事。

en.t: After thinking briefly, he replied, "There is indeed one person who has often puzzled me of late, though I do not know what exactly lies behind her case.

units.source_text: 大将所说的大约就是此人了吧？”

en.t: The person Your Excellency speaks of is probably that woman, is it not?"

units.source_text: 便继续说道：“住在那边的尼僧们到初濑去进香还愿，归途中在一所叫作宇治院的宅子里泊宿。

en.t: He then continued, "The nuns living over there went to Hatsuse to make a pilgrimage and fulfill their vows, and on the way back they spent the night at a residence called Uji-in.

units.source_text: 贫僧的老母由于旅途劳顿，忽然生起病来。

en.t: My aged mother, worn out by the journey, suddenly fell ill.

units.source_text: 随从人等上山来报告，贫僧立刻下山，一到宇治院，就遇到了一件怪事。”

en.t: Her attendants came up the mountain to report it, so I immediately went down, and as soon as I reached Uji-in, I encountered a strange affair."

units.source_text: 他放低声音，悄悄地叙述了找到这女子的经过，又说：“当时老母的病已经濒危，但贫僧顾不得了，只管忧愁如何可把这女子救活。

en.t: Lowering his voice, he quietly described how the woman had been found, and added, "At the time my old mother's illness had already become critical, but I could not attend to that and thought only about how to save this woman.

units.source_text: 看这女子的模样，也已近于死亡，只是还有奄奄一息。

en.t: Judging by her appearance, she too was close to death, with only a faint breath remaining.

units.source_text: 记得古代小说中，曾有灵堂中死尸还魂复活之事，如今所遇到的难道就是这种怪事么？

en.t: I remembered that old tales speak of corpses in spirit halls returning to life; could what we had encountered now be such a strange event?

units.source_text: 实在非常稀奇。

en.t: It was truly extraordinary.

units.source_text: 便把弟子中法术灵验的人从山上召唤下来，轮流替她做祈祷。

en.t: So I summoned down from the mountain the disciples whose rites were most effective, and had them pray for her in turns.

units.source_text: 老母已经到了死不足惜的高龄，但在旅途中患了重病，总须尽力救护，俾得回家安心念佛，往生极乐。

en.t: My mother had reached so great an age that death would not have been especially regrettable, yet since she had fallen gravely ill while traveling, I still had to do all I could to care for her, so that she might return home, recite the Buddha's name in peace, and be reborn in paradise.

units.source_text: 因此贫僧专心为老母祈祷，不曾详细看到这女子的情状。

en.t: For that reason I devoted myself to prayers for my mother and did not observe this woman's condition in detail.

units.source_text: 只是照情况推量，大概是天狗、林妖之类的怪物欺侮她，把她带到那地方的吧。

en.t: From the circumstances alone, I supposed that some creature like a tengu or a forest spirit had tormented her and carried her to that place.

units.source_text: 救活了，带她回到小野之后，曾有三个月不省人事，同死人一样。

en.t: After she was saved and brought back to Ono, she remained unconscious for three months, just like a dead person.

units.source_text: 贫僧的妹妹，乃已故卫门督之妻，现已出家为尼。

en.t: My younger sister, the wife of the late Captain of the Gate Guards, has now taken vows as a nun.

units.source_text: 她只有一个女儿，已经死了多年，她至今还是悼惜不已，时时悲叹。

en.t: She had only one daughter, who died many years ago, and even now she mourns her deeply and often laments her loss.

units.source_text: 如今找到的这个女子，年纪和她的女儿相同，而且相貌非常美丽，她认为是初濑观世音菩萨之所赐，不胜欣喜。

en.t: The woman we had now found was the same age as her daughter and exceedingly beautiful, so my sister believed she was a gift from the Bodhisattva Kannon of Hatsuse and was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 她深恐这女子死去，焦灼万状，啼啼哭哭对贫僧诉苦，要求设法救治。

en.t: She feared terribly that the woman would die, became frantic with anxiety, and came weeping to me, begging me to find some way to save her.

units.source_text: 后来贫僧就下山来到小野，替她举行护身祈祷。

en.t: Later I went down the mountain to Ono and performed protective prayers for her.

units.source_text: 这女子果然渐渐好转，恢复了健康。

en.t: The woman did indeed gradually improve and regained her health.

units.source_text: 但她还是悲伤，向贫僧恳求道：‘我觉得迷住我的鬼怪尚未离开我身。

en.t: But she was still sorrowful and pleaded with me, saying, 'I feel that the spirit that bewitched me has not yet left my body.

units.source_text: 请你给我受戒为尼，让我借此功德来摆脱这鬼怪的侵扰，为后世修福。’

en.t: Please administer the vows and make me a nun, so that through this merit I may escape the spirit's torment and cultivate blessings for the life to come.'

units.source_text: 贫僧身为法师，对此事理应赞善，确曾给她授戒出家。

en.t: As a monk, I naturally had to approve such a wish, and I did indeed administer the vows and let her enter religious life.

units.source_text: 至于此乃大将心爱之人，则全然无由得知。

en.t: As for her being the person beloved by Your Excellency, I had absolutely no way of knowing that.

units.source_text: 贫僧但念此乃世间稀有之事，可做世人谈话资料。

en.t: I merely thought that this was a rare event in the world and might become a subject for people to talk about.

units.source_text: 但小野那些老尼僧深恐传扬出去，引起麻烦，所以严守秘密，数月以来一向不曾告诉别人。”

en.t: But the old nuns at Ono were deeply afraid that if the matter spread it would cause trouble, so they kept it strictly secret and for several months never told anyone."
